I'm seventy-two. Farmed sixty years. Never went to school, can't read. It's just me and my old lady — two of us on ten mu and two fen of land. Not much, but it's what we have, and I know every corner of it.

The wheat went in last October with our own saved seed. No point buying new every year when my own grain grows fine. Now it's April and the wheat's waking up from winter. I always topdress around Qingming with about half a bag of urea per mu — that's my rule, has been for decades. Last year we got four hundred jin per mu, and if the weather don't turn bad, we should get that again. I'll water it twice more before harvest: once now when it's jointing, and maybe once in May if it's dry. The pump electricity costs money, so I don't water more than I have to. I also put down a bit of herbicide in spring if I see weeds coming up.

After wheat harvest in early June, I got maybe five or six days to get the maize in. Too old to do it by hand now, so I hire the tractor with the planter. Hybrid seed from the shop, about fifty-some yuan a mu. I put compound fertilizer in the row at planting, then scatter urea when the maize is knee-high. For maize, maybe one watering in summer if the rains don't come — usually July and August give some rain, so I don't plan on much irrigation.

The stevia is on the other two mu and a bit. My nephew got me into it a few years back — there's a buyer comes to the village. We put seedlings in the ground in late April. It needs less fertilizer than grain, maybe a small bag of urea and some compound per mu. The hard part is picking the leaves in autumn. Me and my wife can't bend and pick all that by ourselves, so I hire women from the village to help — maybe ten days of hired labor. That costs cash, but the stevia brings more money than grain if the price holds.

I don't have much cash in hand. I use urea and diammonium phosphate, the cheap old stuff. The new coated fertilizers are too expensive for me. I'd rather use a bit too much than too little — a bad harvest means we eat less, not just earn less. But I can't afford to go crazy. This year I'll spend about three thousand five hundred yuan on all inputs. That's what I can afford without going to my son for money.
